==> quadlet/roostack-immich-server.container
# Generated by Roostack. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

[Unit]
Description=Roostack immich: server
Requires=roostack-immich-db-main.service
After=roostack-immich-db-main.service
Requires=roostack-immich-db-cache.service
After=roostack-immich-db-cache.service

[Container]
ContainerName=roostack-immich-server
Image=ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:v2.1.0@sha256:72a9b9de6c6abfa7a9c9cdc244ae4d2bd9fea2ae00997f194cbd10aca72ea210
Network=roostack-immich.network
PublishPort=127.0.0.1:20002:2283
Environment=DB_DATABASE_NAME=immich
Environment=DB_HOSTNAME=roostack-immich-db-main
Environment=DB_USERNAME=immich
Environment=IMMICH_MACHINE_LEARNING_ENABLED=false
Environment=IMMICH_MACHINE_LEARNING_URL=http://roostack-immich-machine-learning:3003
Environment=REDIS_HOSTNAME=roostack-immich-db-cache
Secret=roostack-immich-db-main-password,type=env,target=DB_PASSWORD
Volume=/srv/roostack/media/immich/library:/data
Volume=/srv/roostack/media/immich/encoded:/data/encoded-video
Volume=/srv/roostack/media/immich/thumbs:/data/thumbs
Label=io.roostack.service=immich
Label=io.roostack.component=server

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

==> caddy/sites/immich.caddy
# Generated by Roostack for service "immich". Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

@immich-web host photos.lab.example.com
handle @immich-web {
	vars {
		roostack_name immich
		roostack_title "Immich"
		roostack_private no
	}
	@immich-web-outside not {
		remote_ip private_ranges 100.64.0.0/12 100.80.0.0/16 100.82.0.0/15 100.84.0.0/14 100.88.0.0/13 100.96.128.0/17 100.97.0.0/16 100.98.0.0/15 100.104.0.0/13 100.112.0.0/12
		not vars roostack_edge yes
	}
	route {
		crowdsec
		rate_limit {
			zone immich-web-login {
				match {
					path /api/auth/login /api/auth/login/*
				}
				key {remote_host}
				events 10
				window 1m
			}
			zone immich-web {
				key {remote_host}
				events 1000
				window 10s
			}
		}
		appsec @immich-web-outside
		@immich-web-check path_regexp ^/\.well-known/roostack-check/[0-9a-f]{32}$
		reverse_proxy @immich-web-check 169.254.1.3:8480
		request_body {
			max_size 50GB
		}
		reverse_proxy 169.254.1.3:20002
	}
}
